Why partner with the event

real community

Partners engage directly with a focused university audience while supporting accessible cloud learning and practical exposure. Opportunities include visibility across event communication, talent access, exhibit or approved demonstrations, mentoring and educational engagement.

Visibility

Recognition across the event website, selected promotional material, signage and community channels according to the selected package.

Talent access

Meaningful interaction with students exploring cloud, AI, DevOps, data and software careers.

Engagement

Opportunities for an exhibit desk, approved demonstration, mentoring or a proposed educational session.

Community impact

Support hands-on learning, student participation and stronger connections between academia and industry.

Recognition

Acknowledgement before, during and after the event through the benefits defined in the selected package.

Flexible ways to contribute

Custom partnership opportunities

Workshop partner: INR 20,000 or in-kind. Brand recognition for an approved hands-on learning activity; facilitator and content remain subject to programme review.
Refreshment partner: Based on actual cost, with recognition at the supported refreshment area and relevant event communication.
Prize partner: In-kind prizes or INR 10,000+, with recognition during the supported challenge or award segment and selected event material.

Responsible partnerships

Partnership principles

Programme independence. Speaking, workshop and demonstration proposals are reviewed for educational relevance and are not automatically granted through sponsorship.

Participant privacy. Attendee names, email addresses and other personal information will not be shared with partners without separate, explicit consent.

Brand use. Partner logos and brand assets will be displayed only after written permission and according to the confirmed package.

No implied endorsement. Partner recognition does not imply that AWS or Central University of Jammu endorses a partner's products or services.

Administrative compliance. Contributions follow the university's approved process. Benefits begin after written confirmation and receipt of the agreed contribution.

Delivery timelines. Some benefits depend on receiving logos, advertisements and other approved material before production deadlines.
